name: 86 Chaos 16.0.75 Schedule Cache Recovery and Backup Cron Fix
label: 86 Chaos 16.0.75 Schedule Cache Recovery and Backup Cron Fix
releaseTitle: 86 Chaos 16.0.75 Schedule Cache Recovery and Backup Cron Fix
notes: Time Clock & Schedule runtime recovery now clears stale browser caches and service-worker registrations before reloading the current app version.
Production Vercel cron now includes the daily /api/firestore-backup job that the System Administrator backup status expects.
System Administrator API health checks now label HTTP 200 diagnostics with attention items as ATTENTION instead of ERR 200.
